# Evan Handout TSQX Dataset

This dataset was extracted from a local Evan Chen handout corpus. The original
source path is intentionally omitted from the public repository.

using `scripts/extract_evan_tsqx_dataset.py`.

## What Is Included

- `cases/`: preserved TSQX snippets extracted verbatim from handout `.tex` comments
- `manifest.json`: one entry per `asy` block scanned, including figures with no preserved TSQX

## Current Result

- `2` extracted TSQX snippets
- `2` placeholder-only figures with `Source generated by TSQ`
- remaining `asy` figures have no preserved TSQX comment

## Why This Still Matters

The extracted snippets are small but high-quality:

- they come from the original author workflow
- they prefer built-in TSQX constructions over raw Asymptote
- they compile successfully through the local `tsqx -> asy -> pdf` pipeline

## How To Refresh

Run:

```bash
python3 scripts/extract_evan_tsqx_dataset.py \
  /path/to/evan-handouts \
  testdata/evan-handouts
```

## How To Compile The Extracted Cases

Example:

```bash
python3 scripts/verify_tsqx_pipeline.py \
  testdata/evan-handouts/cases/GeoSlang-03-the-iran-incenter-lemma.tsqx \
  --pre \
  --output-dir /tmp/evan-tsqx-check
```
